courses.title: Hands-on Python with Claude Code
courses.titleZh: 用 Claude Code 实战 Python
courses.summary: A challenge course that takes you from a broken script to a tested, verified Python report tool — one sentence starts it in your agent, which fetches the course itself. Task contract, bounded change, and objective pass/fail evidence; guided agent-taught mode included.
courses.summaryZh: 一门挑战课程：从一个跑不起来的脚本到交付一个经过测试与验证的 Python 报表工具——一句话即可在你的 Agent 里开课，课程文件由 Agent 自己获取。任务契约、最小变更与客观的通过/失败证据；内含可选的 Agent 引导模式。
courses.outcome: A working scenario report tool (CSV + JSON inputs, error isolation, rounded aggregates, atomic report writes) that passes a nine-test suite — plus a contract-first workflow you can apply to your own script the same day.
courses.outcomeZh: 一个可运行的场景报表工具（CSV + JSON 输入、错误隔离、聚合舍入、原子写报告），通过九个测试——外加一套当天就能迁移到自己脚本的契约优先工作流。
prerequisites: Python 3.11 or newer available on your PATH
Claude Code 2.x installed and signed in
Comfort running shell commands; no Python packages are installed
No prior testing experience required
prerequisitesZh: PATH 中有 Python 3.11 或更新版本
已安装并登录 Claude Code 2.x
能运行 shell 命令；无需安装任何 Python 包
不要求有测试经验

lessons.title: Set up Claude Code, install the FlyPython Skill, fetch the course
lessons.titleZh: 装好 Claude Code、装上 FlyPython Skill、让 Agent 取回课程
lessons.objective: Start Claude Code, authorize the FlyPython Skill, fetch this course's files, and run the starter's objective check.
lessons.objectiveZh: 启动 Claude Code、授权 FlyPython Skill、取回本课文件，并运行 starter 的客观检查。

lessons.title: Write the task contract before the change
lessons.titleZh: 动手之前先写任务契约
lessons.objective: Turn “make it better” into testable contract statements, trace each to a test, and write one contract line for your own project.
lessons.objectiveZh: 把「优化一下」变成可测试的契约陈述，逐条对应到测试，并为自己的项目写出一条契约。

lessons.title: Drive a bounded change, test by test
lessons.titleZh: 按测试驱动一次有边界的变更
lessons.objective: Supervise the agent through seven small diffs — smallest change, no new dependencies, one failing test group at a time — until the starter passes.
lessons.objectiveZh: 监督 Agent 完成七个小 diff——最小变更、不新增依赖、一次一组测试——直到 starter 通过。

lessons.title: Verify like an engineer, review like a skeptic
lessons.titleZh: 像工程师一样验证，像怀疑者一样审查
lessons.objective: Complete the evidence loop: verify both directions, exercise all three scenario skins, review the diff for scope creep, and record what is not proven.
lessons.objectiveZh: 完成证据闭环：双向验证、跑通三个场景皮肤、审查 diff 是否越界，并记录未证明的部分。

lessons.title: Apply this to your own project
lessons.titleZh: 把这套方法带回你自己的项目
lessons.objective: Port the workflow — not the code — to one script you own, with a contract, one new failing test made to pass, and an honest verification record.
lessons.objectiveZh: 把工作流（而不是代码）迁移到你自己的一个脚本上：一份契约、一个从红变绿的测试、一份诚实的验证记录。

scenarios.title: Excel / report automation
scenarios.blurb: Turn a messy weekly orders export into a per-region sales summary.
scenarios.blurbZh: 把混乱的每周订单导出变成按区域汇总的销售摘要。

scenarios.title: Data monitor script
scenarios.blurb: Aggregate service latency numbers and isolate malformed readings.
scenarios.blurbZh: 汇总服务延迟数据，并隔离格式错误的读数。

scenarios.title: Small API tool
scenarios.blurb: Summarize ticket data pulled from an internal API (JSON input).
scenarios.blurbZh: 汇总从内部 API 拉取的工单数据（JSON 输入）。

verification.method: The course ships a nine-test contract suite. The starter must reproduce seven named failures; the reviewed solution passes 9/9. The same suite verifies your own bounded change in lesson 3.
verification.methodZh: 课程自带九个测试的契约套件。starter 必须复现七个具名失败；已审核的实现 9/9 通过。第 3 课中同一套件验证你自己的最小变更。

courses.title: Hands-on with the OpenAI Codex App

courses.summary: The same verified Python workflow as the Claude Code course — task contract, bounded change, objective verify.py evidence — taught hands-on in the Codex desktop app: threads, approvals, AGENTS.md, and diff review.
courses.summaryZh: 与 Claude Code 课程相同的已验证 Python 工作流——任务契约、有界改动、客观 verify.py 证据——在 Codex 桌面应用里实战：线程、审批、AGENTS.md 与 diff 审查。
courses.outcome: The same tested report tool as the flagship course (identical contract and nine-test suite), driven through the Codex desktop app — plus a thread-and-approval workflow that transfers to any capable coding agent.
courses.outcomeZh: 与旗舰课程相同的报表工具（同一契约、同一九测套件），改由 Codex 桌面应用驱动——外加一套可迁移到任何编码 Agent 的线程与审批工作流。
prerequisites: Python 3.11 or newer available on your PATH
The Codex desktop app (macOS or Windows) signed in with a ChatGPT account
Comfort running shell commands; no Python packages are installed
No prior testing experience required
prerequisitesZh: PATH 中有 Python 3.11 或更新版本
装有 Codex 桌面应用（macOS 或 Windows）并已登录 ChatGPT 账号
能运行 shell 命令；无需安装任何 Python 包
不要求有测试经验

lessons.objectiveZh: 启动 Codex 桌面应用、授权 FlyPython Skill、取回本课文件，并运行 starter 的客观检查。

lessons.title: Write the task contract, let AGENTS.md carry the rules

lessons.objectiveZh: 把「优化一下」变成有边界、可测试的陈述——再把工作规则写进 AGENTS.md，让每个线程自动继承。

lessons.title: The bounded change, reviewed hunk by hunk
lessons.titleZh: 有界改动，逐块审 diff
lessons.objective: Supervise Codex through small diffs — smallest change, no new dependencies, one failing test group at a time — using the app's diff review and approvals.
lessons.objectiveZh: 借助应用的 diff 审查与审批，监督 Codex 逐个小 diff 推进——最小变更、不新增依赖、一次一组失败测试。

lessons.title: Verify like a reviewer, not a spectator
lessons.titleZh: 像评审者一样验证，别当观众
lessons.objective: Complete the evidence loop — both verification directions, all three skins, a scope-creep diff review, and a written record of what is not proven.
lessons.objectiveZh: 完成证据闭环——双向验证、三个皮肤、范围蔓延 diff 审查，以及一份写明未证明内容的记录。

lessons.title: Take the workflow to your own project
lessons.titleZh: 把工作流带回自己的项目
lessons.objective: Port the workflow — not the code — to one script you own, with tests, a verify command, and honest limits.
lessons.objectiveZh: 迁移工作流——而不是代码——到你拥有的一个脚本上，附测试、验证命令与诚实的局限说明。

lessons.title: Set up ZCode, install the FlyPython Skill, fetch the course

lessons.title: Write the task contract, let Goal Mode hold the plan
lessons.titleZh: 写任务契约，让 Goal 模式承载计划
lessons.objective: Turn “make it better” into bounded, testable statements — then watch Goal Mode decompose it into tasks before anything edits.
lessons.objectiveZh: 把「优化一下」变成有边界、可测试的陈述——再看 Goal 模式把它拆成任务，然后才许动文件。

lessons.title: The bounded change, watched task by task
lessons.titleZh: 有界改动，逐任务盯守
lessons.objective: Supervise the goal's task list through small changes — smallest change, no new dependencies, one failing test group at a time — checking the Git state after each task.
lessons.objectiveZh: 沿目标的任务列表逐个守小改动——最小变更、不新增依赖、一次一组失败测试——每个任务后核对 Git 状态。

lessons.title: Verify like a reviewer, not a spectator
lessons.titleZh: 像评审者一样验证，别当观众
lessons.objective: Complete the evidence loop — both verification directions, all three skins, an accumulated Git-diff review, and a written record of what is not proven.
lessons.objectiveZh: 完成证据闭环——双向验证、三个皮肤、累积 Git diff 评审，以及一份写明未证明内容的记录。

lessons.title: Take the workflow to your own project
lessons.titleZh: 把工作流带回自己的项目
lessons.objective: Port the workflow — not the code — to one script you own, with tests, a verify command, and honest limits.
lessons.objectiveZh: 迁移工作流——而不是代码——到你拥有的一个脚本上，附测试、验证命令与诚实的局限说明。

courses.title: One source of truth for agent rules
courses.summary: Stop maintaining diverging AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and .cursorrules files — build a checker that proves your repository has exactly one rule source.
courses.summaryZh: 不再同时维护彼此打架的 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md 与 .cursorrules——亲手构建一个能证明仓库只有一处规则真源的检查器。
courses.outcome: A working rule-consistency checker (rules_check.py) that fails CI the moment a rule file drifts from AGENTS.md — plus the single-source setup applied to your own repository.
courses.outcomeZh: 一个可运行的规则一致性检查器（rules_check.py）——任何规则文件偏离 AGENTS.md 的那一刻，CI 就会失败——外加应用到你自己仓库的单一真源配置。
prerequisites: Python 3.11 or newer available on your PATH
Any coding agent that reads AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or .cursorrules
Comfort running shell commands; standard library only
prerequisitesZh: PATH 中有 Python 3.11 或更新版本
任一会读 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md 或 .cursorrules 的编码 Agent
能运行 shell 命令；仅用标准库

lessons.title: Measure the drift you already have
lessons.titleZh: 量化你已经存在的漂移
lessons.objective: Run the checker against three scenario repositories and read drift as a test failure, not a vibe.
lessons.objectiveZh: 对三个场景仓库运行检查器，把漂移读成测试失败，而不是一种感觉。

lessons.title: Decide the source of truth
lessons.titleZh: 确定唯一真源
lessons.objective: AGENTS.md becomes the one file agents read; everything else is a pointer or a copy.
lessons.objectiveZh: AGENTS.md 成为 Agent 唯一阅读的文件；其余都只能是指针或副本。

lessons.title: Drive a bounded change, test by test
lessons.titleZh: 按测试驱动一次有边界的变更
lessons.objective: Make the starter detect source, pointer, copy, and drift — one failing test group at a time.
lessons.objectiveZh: 让 starter 依次识别真源、指针、副本与漂移——一次一组失败测试。

lessons.title: Verify and wire it in
lessons.titleZh: 验证并接入流程
lessons.objective: Prove both verifier directions, run all three skins, then add the checker to your review loop.
lessons.objectiveZh: 证明验证器双向通过、跑完三个皮肤，然后把检查器接入你的审查环。

lessons.title: Apply this to your repository
lessons.titleZh: 把这套方法带回你的仓库
lessons.objective: One AGENTS.md, thin pointers everywhere else, and a failing check when it breaks.
lessons.objectiveZh: 一个 AGENTS.md，其余全是瘦指针，一旦破坏检查就失败。

scenarios.title: Healthy: thin pointers
scenarios.blurb: AGENTS.md plus two thin pointer files that defer to it.
scenarios.blurbZh: AGENTS.md 加两个指向它的瘦指针文件。

scenarios.title: Healthy: exact copy
scenarios.blurb: AGENTS.md plus one byte-identical copy in CLAUDE.md.
scenarios.blurbZh: AGENTS.md 加一份逐字节一致的 CLAUDE.md 副本。

scenarios.title: Broken: drifted .cursorrules
scenarios.blurb: A stale full ruleset that contradicts AGENTS.md — the drift to catch.
scenarios.blurbZh: 一份与 AGENTS.md 矛盾的过期完整规则集——要捕获的漂移。

verification.method: An 11-test suite pins pointer detection, the source requirement, copy and drift classification, and CLI exit codes; the starter reproduces six named failures, the solution passes 11/11.
verification.methodZh: 11 个测试的套件锚定指针识别、真源要求、副本与漂移分类及 CLI 退出码；starter 复现六个具名失败，solution 通过 11/11。

courses.level: Maintains rule files for multiple tools

courses.title: From “it runs” to “it ships”: verifying AI-generated code
courses.titleZh: 从「能跑」到「能上线」：验证 AI 写的代码
courses.summary: Build the release-evidence machine your AI-written project is missing — a ship check that parses what actually ran, refuses zero-test projects, and writes an honest delivery record.
courses.summaryZh: 为你的 AI 项目补上缺失的发布证据机器——一个 ship check：解析实际跑了什么、拒绝零测试项目，并写出诚实的交付记录。
courses.outcome: ship_check.py: one command that turns “the demo worked” into a written delivery record — command, exit code, parsed test count, a verdict that refuses projects with no tests, and an explicit unverified list.
courses.outcomeZh: ship_check.py：一条命令把「演示能跑」变成一份书面交付记录——命令、退出码、解析出的测试数、一个拒绝零测试项目的判定，以及一份显式的未验证清单。
prerequisites: Python 3.11 or newer available on your PATH
A small Python project you want to ship more safely
Comfort running shell commands; standard library only
prerequisitesZh: PATH 中有 Python 3.11 或更新版本
一个想交付得更稳的小型 Python 项目
能运行 shell 命令；仅用标准库

lessons.title: “It runs” is not evidence
lessons.titleZh: “能跑”不是证据
lessons.objective: Watch the starter bless a project with no tests and one with a failing test — then want better.
lessons.objectiveZh: 看着 starter 给零测试的项目和有失败测试的项目都盖章放行——然后想要更好的东西。

lessons.title: Define what a release record must prove
lessons.titleZh: 定义发布记录必须证明什么
lessons.objective: Command, exit code, parsed count and outcome, an unverified list, and a verdict that refuses zero-test projects.
lessons.objectiveZh: 命令、退出码、解析出的数量与结果、一份未验证清单，以及一个拒绝零测试项目的判定。

lessons.title: Build the ship check, test by test
lessons.titleZh: 按测试逐组构建 ship check
lessons.objective: Parsing, verdicts, the unverified list, atomic writes, exit codes — one failing group at a time.
lessons.objectiveZh: 解析、判定、未验证清单、原子写入、退出码——一次一组失败测试。

lessons.title: Read the record like a skeptic
lessons.titleZh: 像怀疑者一样读记录
lessons.objective: Green, red, and no-tests mean different things — prove you can tell them apart.
lessons.objectiveZh: 绿、红、零测试是三件不同的事——证明你能分辨。

lessons.title: Gate your next release
lessons.titleZh: 给你的下一次发布装上门禁
lessons.objective: Take the ship check to a project you own and make the record part of shipping.
lessons.objectiveZh: 把 ship check 带到你自己的项目，让记录成为交付的一部分。

scenarios.title: Two passing tests
scenarios.blurb: A tiny project with two passing tests and a declared unverified list.
scenarios.blurbZh: 一个带两个通过测试和已声明未验证清单的小项目。

scenarios.title: One wrong expectation
scenarios.blurb: The regression under study: one deliberately wrong test expectation.
scenarios.blurbZh: 正在研究的回归：一个故意写错的测试断言。

scenarios.title: Zero tests
scenarios.blurb: The state that must never pass: no tests at all.
scenarios.blurbZh: 绝不能放行的状态：一个测试都没有。

verification.method: A 10-test suite pins parsed counts, the no-tests verdict, the unverified list, atomic record writes, and CLI exit codes; the starter reproduces seven named failures, the solution passes 10/10.
verification.methodZh: 10 个测试的套件锚定解析计数、零测试判定、未验证清单、原子记录写入及 CLI 退出码；starter 复现七个具名失败，solution 通过 10/10。

courses.title: Give your agent tools with MCP (Python)
courses.titleZh: 用 MCP 给你的 Agent 装上工具（Python）
courses.summary: Build a stateless Model Context Protocol tool server in pure Python — JSON-RPC 2.0 dispatch, schema validation, error isolation, and the 2026-07-28 input_required round-trip.
courses.summaryZh: 用纯 Python 构建一个无状态的 MCP 工具服务——JSON-RPC 2.0 分发、schema 校验、错误隔离与 2026-07-28 的 input_required 多轮交互。
courses.outcome: A working MCP tool server implementing the stateless 2026-07-28 specification: no initialize handshake, validated tool arguments, isolated handler failures, and the multi-round input_required flow.
courses.outcomeZh: 一个实现无状态 2026-07-28 规范的 MCP 工具服务：无 initialize 握手、参数校验、处理异常隔离、input_required 多轮交互。
prerequisites: Python 3.11 or newer available on your PATH
Comfort reading JSON; no API key or model account needed
Any coding agent; standard library only
prerequisitesZh: PATH 中有 Python 3.11 或更新版本
能读 JSON；无需 API Key 或模型账号
任一编码 Agent；仅用标准库

lessons.title: What MCP actually is (2026-07-28)
lessons.titleZh: MCP 到底是什么（2026-07-28）
lessons.objective: A stateless JSON-RPC 2.0 surface for tools — no handshake, no sessions, versions in _meta.
lessons.objectiveZh: 一个面向工具的无状态 JSON-RPC 2.0 接口——无握手、无会话、版本放在 _meta 里。

lessons.title: The JSON-RPC dispatch contract
lessons.titleZh: JSON-RPC 分发契约
lessons.objective: Valid requests echo their id; invalid ones get -32600; unknown or removed methods get -32601.
lessons.objectiveZh: 合法请求回显 id；非法请求得 -32600；未知或已移除的方法得 -32601。

lessons.title: Validation and error isolation
lessons.titleZh: 校验与错误隔离
lessons.objective: Arguments are untrusted input: validate before execution, and never let a handler crash the transport.
lessons.objectiveZh: 参数是不可信输入：先校验再执行，绝不让处理函数打断传输。

lessons.title: The input_required round-trip
lessons.titleZh: input_required 多轮交互
lessons.objective: A tool can ask the client a question mid-call — return the requests, finish on the retry carrying answers.
lessons.objectiveZh: 工具可以在调用中途向客户端提问——先返回问题，客户端带答案重试后完成。

lessons.title: Expose one real tool to your agent
lessons.titleZh: 给你的 Agent 暴露一个真实工具
lessons.objective: Wrap one function you actually own behind the validated, isolated boundary you just built.
lessons.objectiveZh: 把你真正拥有的一个函数包进刚建好的「校验 + 隔离」边界。

scenarios.blurbZh: 一次缺少必填参数的 tools/call。

scenarios.blurbZh: 调用 2026-07-28 规范已移除的方法。

courses.titleZh: 用 Python 构建 LLM 功能：结构化输出、工具调用与评测
courses.summary: Turn a demo-day model call into a feature you can ship — validate structured output, allowlist tool calls, retry with the error fed back, fall back to a human instead of guessing, and measure it with an offline eval that divides by every case.
courses.summaryZh: 把演示日的一次模型调用变成能上线的功能——校验结构化输出、给工具调用设白名单、带着错误信息重试、拿不准就转人工而不是瞎猜，并用分母覆盖全部用例的离线评测来度量。
courses.outcome: A working ticket-triage feature (ticket_triage.py) that treats every model reply as untrusted input — validated output contract, tool-call allowlist, retry with the error fed back, human fallback — plus an offline eval with a pass/fail threshold you can replay on every change.
courses.outcomeZh: 一个可运行的工单分诊功能（ticket_triage.py）：把每条模型回复当成不可信输入——经过校验的输出契约、工具调用白名单、带错误反馈的重试、人工兜底——外加一个每次改动都能回放、带通过阈值的离线评测。

任一装好 FlyPython Skill 的编码 Agent
能运行 shell 命令；仅用标准库
不需要模型 API Key，也不需要联网

lessons.title: A demo reply is not a feature
lessons.titleZh: 演示能跑不等于功能可靠
lessons.objective: Run the starter's eval, catch the number that cannot be true, and map every failing test to the real-world reply that breaks it.
lessons.objectiveZh: 跑一遍 starter 的评测，抓住那个不可能为真的数字，再把每个失败测试对应到让它坏掉的真实回复。

lessons.title: Write the output contract
lessons.titleZh: 把模型输出写成契约
lessons.objective: Read TASK.md as the boundary between your code and the model — what a reply must look like, which tools it may run, and what happens when it does not comply.
lessons.objectiveZh: 把 TASK.md 当成你的代码与模型之间的边界来读——回复必须长什么样、能运行哪些工具、不照做时怎么办。

lessons.title: Validate, allowlist tools, retry — one group at a time
lessons.titleZh: 校验、工具白名单、重试——一次一组
lessons.objective: Drive the starter to green in four bounded turns — parser, tool gate, retry-and-fallback loop, eval — and watch one fix expose a bug the old code was hiding.
lessons.objectiveZh: 用四个有界轮次把 starter 推到全绿——解析器、工具关口、重试与兜底循环、评测——并亲眼看到一处修复暴露出旧代码藏着的 bug。

lessons.title: Read the eval honestly
lessons.titleZh: 诚实地读评测
lessons.objective: Run all three skins, accept the one that fails its threshold, and write down what a handful of recorded replies can and cannot tell you.
lessons.objectiveZh: 跑完三个皮肤，接受那个没过阈值的结果，并写下少量录好的回复能说明什么、不能说明什么。

lessons.title: Apply it to your own LLM feature
lessons.titleZh: 接到你自己的模型功能上
lessons.objective: Put a real model behind the same seam: a callable client, an output contract, an allowlist, a fallback, and an eval you record once and replay on every change.
lessons.objectiveZh: 把真实模型放到同一个接缝后面：一个可调用的 client、一份输出契约、一张白名单、一个兜底，以及录一次、每次改动都回放的评测。

scenarios.title: IT helpdesk with a device lookup tool
scenarios.titleZh: IT 服务台（带设备查询工具）
scenarios.blurb: Classify internal tickets into five categories; the model may look up a device by asset tag first.
scenarios.blurbZh: 把内部工单分到五个类别；模型可以先按资产标签查询设备。

scenarios.title: SaaS feedback inbox
scenarios.blurb: Classify in-app feedback with no tools at all — the model answers from the ticket text alone.
scenarios.blurbZh: 完全不带工具地分类应用内反馈——模型只凭工单文本作答。

scenarios.title: Shop support with an order lookup tool
scenarios.titleZh: 商店客服（带订单查询工具）
scenarios.blurb: Classify a shop's support mail; the model may look up an order before answering.
scenarios.blurbZh: 分类商店的客服邮件；模型可以先查询订单再作答。

verification.method: A 15-test suite pins the output contract, the tool-call allowlist, retry with error feedback, the human fallback, and an eval that divides by every case. The starter reproduces the named failures; the reviewed solution passes 15/15 against recorded replies — no network, no API key.
verification.methodZh: 15 个测试锚定输出契约、工具调用白名单、带错误反馈的重试、人工兜底，以及分母覆盖全部用例的评测。starter 复现具名失败；已审核的实现对着录制回复通过 15/15——无需联网、无需 API Key。

badge.nameZh: 模型输出是不可信输入

courses.level: Comfortable with functions, dictionaries, and exceptions
courses.levelZh: 熟悉函数、字典与异常处理

courses.tool: Any coding agent + an attack-replay harness
courses.toolZh: 任一编码 Agent + 攻击重放装置
courses.title: Security review for AI-written Python
courses.titleZh: AI 写的 Python 代码的安全审查
courses.summary: Review a plausible, AI-style notes service the way an attacker would — close SQL injection, path traversal, a hard-coded secret, fast password hashes, and pickled sessions one class at a time, then prove each fix by replaying the attacks.
courses.summaryZh: 像攻击者一样审查一个看起来没问题、AI 风格的笔记服务——一次一类地堵上 SQL 注入、路径穿越、硬编码密钥、快速密码哈希和 pickle 会话，再通过重放攻击证明每处修复。
courses.outcome: Every one of nine recorded attacks blocked, an attack-replay command that proves it on both scenario skins, and a five-question review habit for the next repository your assistant writes.
courses.outcomeZh: 九个录制攻击全部被挡下、一条能在两个场景皮肤上证明此事的重放命令，以及一套能带去下一个仓库的五问审查习惯。
prerequisites: Python 3.11 or newer available on your PATH
Any coding agent with the FlyPython Skill installed
Comfort running shell commands; standard library only
Can read Python functions with file and SQL operations
prerequisitesZh: PATH 中有 Python 3.11 或更新版本
任一装好 FlyPython Skill 的编码 Agent
能运行 shell 命令；仅用标准库
能读懂带文件与 SQL 操作的 Python 函数

lessons.title: Plausible is not safe
lessons.titleZh: 看起来对不等于安全
lessons.objective: Read a notes service that looks fine, then replay nine attacks against it and watch every one succeed.
lessons.objectiveZh: 读一个看起来没问题的笔记服务，然后对它重放九个攻击，看着每一个都得手。

lessons.title: Write the threat model as a contract
lessons.titleZh: 把威胁模型写成契约
lessons.objective: For each function, name who controls the input, what they want, and what the code must refuse — then trace every refusal to a test and the Python documentation behind it.
lessons.objectiveZh: 对每个函数，说清谁控制输入、他想要什么、代码必须拒绝什么——再把每一条拒绝追查到一个测试，以及它背后的 Python 文档。

lessons.title: Close one flaw class per turn
lessons.titleZh: 每轮只堵一类漏洞
lessons.objective: Five bounded turns — search, attachments, secret key, passwords, sessions — each closing one weakness class with a mechanism, never a filter, each proven by tests and the replay.
lessons.objectiveZh: 五个有界轮次——搜索、附件、密钥、密码、会话——每轮用机制（绝不用过滤）堵上一类弱点，并用测试和重放证明。

lessons.title: Review like an attacker
lessons.titleZh: 像攻击者一样复查
lessons.objective: Replay the second skin, run a static scanner and note what it misses, attack one thing the suite never tried, and write down what is still unreviewed.
lessons.objectiveZh: 重放第二个皮肤、跑一遍静态扫描并记下它漏了什么、攻击一处套件从没试过的地方，并写下还有什么没审查。

lessons.title: Review your own AI-written code
lessons.titleZh: 审查你自己的 AI 代码
lessons.objective: Take the five questions and the scanner pass to a repository you own: find where input crosses a trust boundary, check each crossing for a mechanism, and write down what you did not review.
lessons.objectiveZh: 把五个问题和扫描步骤带到你自己的仓库：找出输入跨越信任边界的地方，检查每处是否用了机制，并写下你没有审查的部分。

scenarios.title: Clinic visit notes
scenarios.blurb: A small clinic's visit notes — every note belongs to one clinician; attachments live under a scans folder. All names and records are fictional.
scenarios.blurbZh: 一家小诊所的就诊记录——每条记录只属于一位医生，附件放在 scans 目录下。所有人名与记录均为虚构。

scenarios.title: Team shared notes
scenarios.blurb: A small team's shared notes app: search, attachments, logins, and sessions.
scenarios.blurbZh: 一个小团队的共享笔记应用：搜索、附件、登录与会话。

verification.method: A 16-test suite plus an attack-replay harness covering nine attacks per skin — SQL injection, path traversal, secret disclosure, weak password hashes, and pickled sessions. The starter lets all nine through; the reviewed solution blocks 9/9 on both skins.
verification.methodZh: 16 个测试的套件，外加每个皮肤重放九个攻击的装置——SQL 注入、路径穿越、密钥泄露、弱密码哈希与 pickle 会话。starter 对九个攻击全部放行；已审核的实现两个皮肤均 9/9 拦截。

courses.level: Reads Python with file and SQL operations comfortably
courses.levelZh: 能顺畅读懂带文件与 SQL 操作的 Python

courses.title: Exploratory Data Analysis with an Agent
courses.titleZh: 用 Agent 做探索性数据分析
courses.summary: A challenge course — point your agent at a messy shop export and produce a verified EDA summary whose numbers are checked against ground truth.
courses.summaryZh: 一门挑战课程——让你的 Agent 处理一份脏的商店导出数据，产出一份经过真值校验的 EDA 摘要。
courses.outcome: A pandas script that cleans a 142-row messy export (duplicates, bad amounts, bad dates) and writes results.json verified against ground truth — the load → clean → summarize pipeline you can port to your own data.
courses.outcomeZh: 一个 pandas 脚本：清洗 142 行脏导出（重复、坏金额、坏日期），产出经真值校验的 results.json——一套可以迁移到你自己数据上的加载 → 清洗 → 统计流水线。
prerequisites: Python 3.11 or newer available on your PATH
uv or pip to install the pinned pandas dependency
Any coding agent; no pandas experience required
First non-stdlib course — installing the environment is part of the challenge
prerequisitesZh: PATH 中有 Python 3.11 或更新版本
用 uv 或 pip 安装锁定的 pandas 依赖
任一编码 Agent；不要求 pandas 经验
第一门非标准库课程——装环境本身就是挑战的一部分

lessons.title: What messy data looks like
lessons.titleZh: 脏数据长什么样
lessons.objective: Profile the CSV before touching code: total rows, exact duplicates, unparseable amounts and dates.
lessons.objectiveZh: 写代码前先给 CSV 做画像：总行数、完全重复行、不可解析的金额与日期。

lessons.title: Define the answer first
lessons.titleZh: 先定答案
lessons.objective: Write down the expected results.json shape — keys, types, rounding — before letting the agent generate code.
lessons.objectiveZh: 在让 Agent 生成代码之前，先写下期望的 results.json 结构——键、类型、舍入规则。

lessons.title: Clean and summarize
lessons.titleZh: 清洗与统计
lessons.objective: Implement the contract in starter/eda.py: load, clean with counted removals, summarize, write results.json.
lessons.objectiveZh: 在 starter/eda.py 里实现契约：加载、按计数清洗、统计、写出 results.json。

lessons.title: Check against ground truth
lessons.titleZh: 核对真值
lessons.objective: The suite asserts exact numbers — 142 in, 137 clean, total revenue 33347.89 — plausible-but-different numbers are a fail.
lessons.objectiveZh: 套件断言精确数字——输入 142 行、清洗后 137、总收入 33347.89——看似合理但不同的数字就是失败。

lessons.title: Run it on your own data
lessons.titleZh: 换成你自己的数据
lessons.objective: Port the pipeline to a real export you own and name one assumption that broke.
lessons.objectiveZh: 把流水线迁移到你真实的一份导出上，并说出一条不成立的假设。

scenarios.title: Messy shop export
scenarios.blurb: 142 rows with exact duplicates, unparseable amounts, and a bad date.
scenarios.blurbZh: 142 行，含完全重复、不可解析金额与一条坏日期。

verification.method: Twelve-test contract suite asserting exact numbers against ground truth. The starter must reproduce the unfinished state; the reviewed solution passes 12/12.
verification.methodZh: 十二个测试的契约套件，按真值断言精确数字。starter 必须复现未完成状态；已审核实现 12/12 通过。

courses.levelZh: 新手向；第一门 pandas 课程

courses.title: Data Visualization with an Agent
courses.titleZh: 用 Agent 做数据可视化
courses.summary: A challenge course — turn a clean sales dataset into three spec'd charts plus a summary.json whose numbers are verified against the data.
courses.summaryZh: 一门挑战课程——把干净的销售数据变成三张有规格的图和一份 summary.json，其中数字与数据集校验一致。
courses.outcome: A matplotlib script producing three valid PNG charts and a summary.json — the machine-checkable half of “here are my charts”, with an honest statement of what verification cannot see.
courses.outcomeZh: 一个 matplotlib 脚本，产出三张合法 PNG 图和一份 summary.json——“这是我的图”中可机器核查的那一半，外加一句诚实说明验证看不到什么。
prerequisites: Python 3.11 or newer available on your PATH
uv or pip to install pinned pandas + matplotlib
Any coding agent
Completing da-eda first is recommended, not required
prerequisitesZh: PATH 中有 Python 3.11 或更新版本
用 uv 或 pip 安装锁定的 pandas + matplotlib
任一编码 Agent
建议先完成 da-eda，非必需

lessons.title: A chart is packaged evidence
lessons.titleZh: 图是证据的包装
lessons.objective: State the claim behind each required chart before writing code — a wrong claim makes a pretty chart worse than none.
lessons.objectiveZh: 写代码前先说出每张图在声称什么——声称错了，图越漂亮越糟糕。

lessons.title: Spec first, chart second
lessons.titleZh: 先写规格，再画图
lessons.objective: Map each output file to its source aggregation before letting the agent render anything.
lessons.objectiveZh: 在让 Agent 渲染之前，把每个输出文件映射到它的聚合来源。

lessons.title: Three charts and a summary
lessons.titleZh: 三张图与摘要
lessons.objective: Implement the contract in starter/charts.py — Agg backend, parsed dates, real PNG output.
lessons.objectiveZh: 在 starter/charts.py 里实现契约——Agg 后端、解析日期、产出真 PNG。

lessons.title: Numbers match the charts
lessons.titleZh: 数字与图一致
lessons.objective: summary.json is the auditable layer — verified against dataset ground truth.
lessons.objectiveZh: summary.json 是可审计层——与数据集真值校验。

lessons.title: What verification cannot see
lessons.titleZh: 验证看不到的东西
lessons.objective: Write the sentence stating what was and was not verified — the suite does not judge aesthetics or honest scales.
lessons.objectiveZh: 写下一句话说明验证了什么、没验证什么——套件不评价美观与坐标轴诚实性。

scenarios.title: Clean daily sales
scenarios.blurb: 135 rows of long-format daily revenue across three regions.
scenarios.blurbZh: 135 行长格式数据，三个地区的每日收入。

verification.method: Five-test contract suite: PNG magic bytes and file sizes, summary.json numbers against ground truth. The starter must reproduce the unfinished state.
verification.methodZh: 五个测试的契约套件：PNG 魔数与文件大小、summary.json 数字对真值。starter 必须复现未完成状态。

courses.title: From Analysis to Report with an Agent
courses.titleZh: 用 Agent 从分析到报告
courses.summary: A challenge course — turn a verified EDA summary into report.json + report.md where every number traces back to its input unchanged.
courses.summaryZh: 一门挑战课程——把经过验证的 EDA 摘要变成 report.json + report.md，其中每个数字都可原样回溯到输入。
courses.outcome: A report generator that produces a machine-readable report.json and a human-readable report.md — the auditable structure that separates “a report exists” from “the numbers are traceable”.
courses.outcomeZh: 一个报告生成器：产出机器可读的 report.json 和人可读的 report.md——把“有份报告”和“数字可回溯”分开的可审计结构。
prerequisites: Python 3.11 or newer available on your PATH
uv or pip to install the pinned pandas dependency
Any coding agent
Completing da-eda first is recommended, not required
prerequisitesZh: PATH 中有 Python 3.11 或更新版本
用 uv 或 pip 安装锁定的 pandas 依赖
任一编码 Agent
建议先完成 da-eda，非必需

lessons.title: A report is a contract with the reader
lessons.titleZh: 报告是与读者的契约
lessons.objective: Trace every number the report must carry back to its source field in results.json.
lessons.objectiveZh: 把报告必须携带的每个数字回溯到 results.json 的来源字段。

lessons.title: Structure before prose
lessons.titleZh: 先结构，后文字
lessons.objective: Decide the skeleton — title, section order, metrics block — before writing any prose.
lessons.objectiveZh: 先定骨架——标题、章节顺序、metrics 块——再写任何文字。

lessons.title: Build and render the report
lessons.titleZh: 构建并渲染报告
lessons.objective: Implement the contract in starter/report.py — metrics carried unchanged, sections in order, numbers formatted.
lessons.objectiveZh: 在 starter/report.py 里实现契约——指标原样传递、章节按序、数字格式化。

lessons.title: Numbers traceable to inputs
lessons.titleZh: 数字可回溯到输入
lessons.objective: Every metric equals its source field — the audit answer is a field name, not an explanation.
lessons.objectiveZh: 每个指标等于来源字段——审计答案是字段名，不是解释。

lessons.title: What report verification cannot see
lessons.titleZh: 报告验证看不到的东西
lessons.objective: The suite checks structure and numbers, not insight or honesty — write the boundary sentence.
lessons.objectiveZh: 套件检查结构与数字，不查洞见与诚实——写下那句边界说明。

scenarios.title: Verified analysis pack
scenarios.blurb: A verified EDA summary that your report must trace, not recompute.
scenarios.blurbZh: 一份已验证的 EDA 摘要——你的报告要回溯它，不是重算它。

verification.method: Six-test contract suite: required headings in order, metrics matching inputs exactly, report files written. The starter must reproduce the unfinished state.
verification.methodZh: 六个测试的契约套件：必需标题按序、指标与输入精确一致、报告文件写出。starter 必须复现未完成状态。
